concept.name: Mean absolute percentage error
concept.definition: The average absolute forecast error divided by the absolute observed value, expressed as a ratio or percentage under a stated zero-value convention.
concept.intuition: It summarizes one aspect of prediction error or decision quality in a number or curve.
concept.mechanics: For nonzero targets, divide each absolute residual by the absolute target and average; explicitly handle or exclude zero and near-zero denominators.
concept.failure_modes: Class imbalance, threshold choice, unequal error costs, outliers, and dependence can make the summary inappropriate or unstable.
concept.misconceptions: No single metric captures economic utility, turnover, risk, calibration, and trading costs at once.
concept.example: Actual values 100 and 200 with forecasts 90 and 220 yield MAPE = (10%+10%)/2 = 10%.
